author: Jeremiah, with his scribe Baruch
audience: Judah before and after the fall of Jerusalem
overview: Jeremiah warns Judah for forty years that Babylon will destroy Jerusalem unless they turn back to God. He is mocked, beaten and imprisoned, and weeps over his people. He also promises a "new covenant" in which God will write his law on people's hearts.
storyPlace: The years leading up to the exile.
